reviews_h2: What people are saying about the landscaping

reviews.author: Kayla
reviews.text: They did an amazing job! Very nice people all the way around. They were very efficient in giving me a quote and got straight to work after approving the estimate. I will definitely be doing more business with them!

reviews.author: Kinya Jackson
reviews.text: Been trying to get my yard done for about a week now the lady keep saying he busy when she told me in two weeks they will see me. It’s ridiculous I have to keep texting them to see when he can come out. I don’t know if she don’t care if he needs the money or not . But she will make him lost people

reviews.author: paulette remillard
reviews.text: I would like to extend my gratitude to Mendoza Landscaping for their impressive landscaping services. If you are looking for a skilled landscaper with reasonable rates, I recommend contacting them.

reviews.author: Brian Mathis
reviews.text: Mendoza Landscaping and More started mowing and maintaining our lawn one month ago. They have mowed and trimmed every week for the past 5 weeks and they do fantastic work!!! This is the best our lawn has looked since we moved in. Their attention to detail is great and not only their mowing, but their trim work is very neat. They also blow off and clean up so well you can’t even tell the lawn was mowed. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Davy Limalo
reviews.text: First, we want to say how pleased we were with Mendoza Landscaping. We contacted them to do our mowing when our mower was out of service. Although we were not a regular customer, they treated us as if we were and were able to work us into their schedule. They did a fantastic job. We will use them in the future for other landscaping needs. Give them a call, you won’t be disappointed. A very responsive company.

reviews.author: skdunmire
reviews.text: Very pleased with Mendoza Landscaping! The owner leads the work himself and is focused on detail. High quality work, completed efficiently. A neighbor recommended this company, and we feel lucky to have found them. 100% recommend!

reviews.author: Ayo Stone
reviews.text: They take care of my lawn every 2 weeks when in season. Good work done and they’re in and out. They helped install new flower beds and took care of everything, supplies and all. Definitely recommend for any lawn care / landscaping needs in Horry County and beyond.

reviews.author: Oscar Bestess
reviews.text: He came by my house we discussed what I would have liked to be done. It’s a brand new home. He said he would go figure it out. He left and I tried to call he on 3 separate occasions the following week. No answers. No reply’s to my voicemail’s. I thought he was a decent guy. JUST ANOTHER FLY BY NIGHT. Won’t last by not answering whether you want the job or not. Not good Buisness.

reviews.author: Carolynn Floyd
reviews.text: This is the best landscaping company I have used. They do such an amazing job, I'll never use another landscaper again.

reviews.author: Kimberly Haselden
reviews.text: Did a beautiful job!! Cant ask for better company! And they didnt mind traveling to me to do the job!
